checks.summary: Evaluator manifest, digest, required assets, inventories, and command contracts pass local validation.
All 19 fixed cases passed against the original S5000C build and independent finite-value scalar oracle for the approved digest.
All six workloads completed one warmup and five positive finite raw samples on the original baseline.
Observed one thread, CPU 0 affinity, NUMA node 0 bind, and OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.
Every retained measurement recorded the pinned baseline SHA, dladdr-resolved path, and harness SHA.
Baseline SHA matched before and after each step and after the qualification run.
